meta.notes: Story-mode steps; bodies are templated at export time from the exported numbers. Each selector starts with the data-story attribute the screen renders (story_id), optionally narrowed to a child element so the step card does not cover its subject: mission-kpis, aircraft, forecast-demand-strip, rotable-float-calc, network-bom, frontier-chart, aog-incident-ps1, action-inbox. mobile_selector (or null) is the narrower target used at <= 480 px (bottom-sheet layout); it also starts with the story_id hook.

steps.title: Fewer groundings, at a stated price
steps.body: Across 20 holdout seeds the recommended plan (I125) cuts modelled material AOG from 2,871 to 223 h a year and lifts immediate fill from 95.4% to 98.1%, for AED 5M more spare capital than P0.

steps.title: One urgent part in a review system
steps.body: ATA 32 rates REVIEW as a system (11% of fleet risk-hours, under the 15% urgent bar), but one part in it is URGENT: GN-32-R014, a D0 carbon brake assembly, risk 89/100. With 0 units at BOM under P0, 16 D0 requests in two years of history (W0–W103) became 16 AOG events (144 h).

steps.title: Why its demand is intermittent
steps.body: Its weekly demand is intermittent (ADI 1.69 weeks, CV² 0.35 on training weeks W0–W77). The frozen MASE champion for this cell, 'naive', ranked 9/9 on the holdout, so the policies size rotables on the reliability-exposure rate.

steps.title: Float maths for one rotable
steps.body: Network removals run at 3.5 per 30 days with a 35-day hub pipeline. Spares S, as the calculator counts them (on the shelf + 5 already in the repair loop): P0 10, P2 21, recommended 23. On its 40-day loop, Palm's theorem gives 79% availability for the 2 units P2 places at BOM.

steps.title: Positioning beats reacting
steps.body: At BOM, holdout material AOG falls from 291 h/yr under P0 to 40 under P2, which stocks outstations where the D0 penalty pays for the unit. Each emergency hop from AUH takes 9 h.

steps.title: Where to stop buying
steps.body: The pre-stated rule walks the capital-vs-AOG hull until an extra AED 1M saves fewer than 9.4 AOG h/yr, and stops at I125: AED 41.9M and 223 AOG h/yr on the holdout, against 533 h for P2 at AED 37M.

steps.title: One incident, replayed
steps.body: AOG-0001: A6-FHU (fictional) grounded at BOM for 9 h waiting for a carbon brake assembly. Ranked on what the desk knew then, the top option was: Emergency transfer from AUH.

steps.title: What the planner does on Monday
steps.body: The action centre raises 75 exceptions for W103, 28 urgent. At BOM, GN-32-R014 has 0 of 2 on hand, with 7 D0 requests and 63 AOG h there in the last 52 weeks (W52–W103).
